company_name: Ping An Healthcare and Technology Company Limited

inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted, post-scrip basis: 2,161.44m shares in issue at 30 Jun 2026 (H1 FY2026 interim report, disclosure-of-interests note) + 5.34m dilutive share options (H1 FY2026 EPS note 8b). Issued count used rather than the 2,126.7m weighted average (which nets trust-held award shares) -- conservative. All flows are FY2025/H1 FY2026, i.e. post the Feb-2025 issue of 1,042.6m scrip-dividend shares, so pre- and post-dividend share counts are not mixed. Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows (0.2% of revenue).
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report consolidated cash flow statement, 'Share-based payments' add-back RMB9,838k; no net-share-settlement tax line (EquityAwardTaxes = 0 every period).
inputs.interest_income_note: Finance income, net RMB106.5m (FY2025 P&L) of which RMB51.3m is reversed in the OCF reconciliation and RMB56.3m of term-deposit interest is received in investing, so ~RMB55.2m sits inside reported OCF and is the amount stripped from last_fcf. FVTPL fair-value gains (RMB143.5m) and investment income (RMB5.1m) are already reversed out of OCF. The component build excludes ALL treasury income (finance income, FVTPL gains, other gains) from EBITDA, and the source assets go in at carrying value in net_debt + equity_bridge.
inputs.fx_note: HKD per CNY 1.1733 (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, regularMarketTime 2026-10-16T20:28Z). Cross-check: USDHKD 7.8477 / USDCNY 6.6856 = 1.1738, ties within 0.05%. Per-share values computed in CNY (statements are RMB) then multiplied by 1.1733 to HKD. No dual listing to parity-check. Rate is not refreshed by refresh_price.py -- re-fetch on any update.
inputs.wacc_rationale: RMB-built cost of equity, zero debt so WACC = CoE: China 10y CGB ~1.8% + beta ~1.1 x China ERP ~7.0% + ~0.5% small/HK-listed liquidity = ~10.0%. Same WACC in all three scenarios: related-party concentration and governance risk are charged in the bear flows and the 30% bear weight, not stacked as a WACC premium (adaptations 7f).
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost: lease payments (FY2025 RMB38.3m = 0.7% of revenue, principal+interest from the financing line) charged via lease_cost_pct_path inside EBIT; D&A path is ex right-of-use depreciation (~0.75% of revenue); lease liabilities (RMB29.1m at 30 Jun 2026) EXCLUDED from net debt.
inputs.nci_treatment: Ignored as immaterial: NCI share of H1 FY2026 profit RMB0.4m, NCI equity -RMB10.1m. Flows treated as attributable.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF component route with non-US adaptations (RMB flows, HKD quote, IFRS 16 leases, large non-operating treasury book). Routed as an operating company -- an online health / corporate-wellness services platform that sells into Ping An Group's insurance channels and to enterprises; it is NOT an insurer (no underwriting, no float in the insurance sense), so BVPS/insurer routes do not apply. FY0 = FY2025 revenue RMB5,468.2m. Core operating EBIT (gross profit - S&M - admin + other income - operating impairments, excluding finance income, FVTPL gains, the RMB90m FY2025 provision reversal and the RMB40m associate impairment) was ~RMB109m (2.0%) in FY2025 but RMB177m (7.1%) in H1 FY2026 vs RMB73m in H1 FY2025; H2 is seasonally weak (H2 FY2025 ~RMB36m). FY2026 base EBITDA margin (pre-SBC, pre-lease) 6.8% assumes H2 FY2026 improves by roughly the same absolute amount as H1. Reported FY2025 OCF of RMB451m includes ~RMB193m working-capital inflow (incl. RMB65m restricted-cash release) that does not repeat; component year-1 owner FCF is ~4.5% of revenue vs last_fcf 6.3%. NON-OPERATING ASSETS: at 30 Jun 2026 cash RMB4,421.4m (in net_debt) + term deposits RMB588.7m + FVTPL wealth-management products RMB3,655.4m (equity_bridge, carrying value) = RMB8,665.5m of liquid treasury, matching the Dec-2025 total of RMB8,653m; restricted cash RMB975.8m and associates RMB63m deliberately excluded (restricted / immaterial). The business also runs negative operating working capital (~RMB1.36bn of payables + contract liabilities in excess of receivables/inventory/prepayments), so part of the treasury is customer/supplier float; the full balance is credited (house convention) but this is a ~HK$0.74/share downside sensitivity. Buybacks nil: the flat share count is a modelling convention, not funded. Historical CAGRs are distorted (revenue shrank FY2021-23 as low-margin e-commerce was cut; equity fell on the RMB9.87bn special dividend; EPS/FCF negative at the base), so growth paths are built from segment evidence, not CAGRs.

equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026 interim balance sheet, 30 Jun 2026: 121.772 current + 466.976 non-current

equity_bridge.item: Financial assets at FVTPL (wealth-management products, Ping An AM/WM related-party issuers)
equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026 interim balance sheet: 1,790.277 current + 1,865.161 non-current, at fair value

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: segment mix (corporate health management +40.6% FY2025 / +65.1% H1 FY2026 at ~24-29% of revenue, F-end insurance enablement ~flat) -- historical CAGRs are not usable
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (-9.7%/-8.9%) reflects the FY2024 RMB9.87bn special dividend paid from share premium, not business performance; EPS and owner-FCF CAGRs are undefined (negative base years FY2020-23); revenue CAGR is negative because the FY2021-23 contraction was a deliberate exit from low-margin pharmacy e-commerce.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - in-OCF interest) was negative every year FY2017-FY2023 and turned positive only in FY2024 (~-20) / FY2025 (~346, of which ~193 was working-capital release). SBC fell from RMB127m (FY2018) to RMB9.8m (FY2025).

base.narrative: Corporate health management keeps compounding (to ~40% of revenue) while insurance enablement grows with Ping An's policy volumes; AI and scale take core EBIT from 2% (FY2025) / 7% (H1 FY2026) to ~10% by FY2032.
base.tax_rationale: H1 FY2026 effective rate 12.3% as carried-forward losses run off in profitable subsidiaries; ramps to a blended 20% (mix of 15% HNTE and 25% statutory).

scenario_narratives.base: The H1 FY2026 margin step-up (gross margin 38.5% vs 33.6%, core EBIT 7.1% vs 2.9%) is mostly real but H2 stays seasonally weaker, so FY2026 lands near 5% core EBIT on ~2% revenue growth as the F-end insurance-enablement line plateaus. Corporate health management (+65% in H1) carries group growth to 6-7% for three years, decelerating to 3%; AI cost-per-consultation gains and opex leverage lift core EBIT to ~10% by FY2032 and hold there -- Ping An, as majority owner and dominant customer, is assumed to leave the subsidiary a services margin rather than extract it through pricing. Treasury of RMB8.7bn credited at carrying value.
scenario_narratives.bull: B-end corporate wellness keeps adding 70%+ clients a year and becomes the largest segment, home-based senior care scales across Ping An's ~240m retail customers, and AI (Ping An Medical Master) structurally lowers delivery cost, so revenue compounds at ~10-12% and core EBIT reaches ~14% -- closer to a scaled health-services platform than an insurer's cost centre. Majority ownership is a stable, aligned funnel rather than a cap on margins.
scenario_narratives.bear: Ping An Group, now a 53.7% parent and the source of most revenue, reprices the health-benefit enablement contracts once the subsidiary is visibly profitable -- the H1 FY2026 margin proves a high-water mark and core EBIT reverts toward the FY2025 ~2% level. Insurance-channel volumes soften with Chinese consumer demand, JD Health/Alibaba Health/Meituan compete away the B-end growth, and the 2025-26 board and CEO turnover produces strategic drift. Revenue shrinks 3% in FY2026 and grows ~2% thereafter. The business stays marginally profitable; the value floor is the treasury.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30% from the 15% default: a single related party (the parent) controls both most of the revenue and the pricing, profitability is six quarters old, and the board was largely replaced in Oct-2025/Aug-2026. Base 50% on the evidence of the H1 FY2026 margin step-up. Bull cut to 20% because it needs B-end scaling, AI cost gains and parent forbearance on pricing to all hold at once.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Owner-FCF DCF of the core operating business plus the RMB8.7bn treasury book at carrying value. At the current price the market capitalises the operating business at roughly RMB1.9bn (~6x a FY2026E core EBIT of ~RMB300m), i.e. it either doubts the margin inflection or discounts the related-party-managed cash. Most of the per-share value in every scenario is the treasury; the operating business decides the spread between bear and bull.
key_risks_to_valuation: Related-party pricing: Ping An Group (53.7% owner and main customer) can move margin between parent and subsidiary at will

Treasury is invested in Ping An AM/WM wealth-management products (related-party counterparty) and partly funded by negative operating working capital (~RMB1.36bn float); a cash haircut or a value-destructive acquisition would cut the floor
H2 seasonality: FY2025 H2 core EBIT was only ~RMB36m; a weak H2 FY2026 would put the base margin path one to two years too early
Governance turnover (CEO/chairman Oct-2025, five directors Aug-2026) and strategic drift
Tax: cash rate ramps from ~12% to 20%; faster normalisation to 25% statutory trims ~6% from operating value
